links.comparator_used: Full retraining (also Label-Flip Retraining, Influence Reweighting, and Selective Tree Pruning as alternative unlearning methods)
links.outcome: Unlearning time, accuracy cost versus 0.5% clinical threshold, and cumulative 12-month deletion cost for removing patient data from AMR prediction models
links.effect: SISA achieved an 8.9× speedup over full retraining on ARMD (7.5 s vs. 66.7 s) and 9.8× on PATRIC (1.4 s vs. 13.4 s), with accuracy costs of 0.024% and 0.048%. Over 12 months at 50 monthly deletions, cumulative overhead fell from 800 s to 90 s (ARMD) and from 160 s to 16 s (PATRIC). Label-Flip Retraining and Influence Reweighting gave no speedup (≤1.0×).
links.tradeoff: Small accuracy loss (0.024% ARMD, 0.048% PATRIC), below the 0.5% clinical threshold. Tree Pruning exceeded the threshold on EHR data (+0.648%).
links.quote: SISA achieved an 8.9× speedup over full retraining on ARMD (7.5 s vs. 66.7 s) and a 9.8 × speedup on PATRIC (1.4 s vs. 13.4 s), with accuracy costs of 0.024% and 0.048%, respectively, both below the 0.5% clinical threshold.

design_hint: machine unlearning (SISA) for patient data deletion requests
